title: Line sketch: Smiling Winged Orb
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A cheerful circular head with black eyes, cheek, and curved smile floats at center, framed by large segmented wing or skirt shapes and thin legs casting shadows. Scattered circles hover in the upper background against a pale field. Bold flat color fields and crisp outlines create a graphic, stylized composition (derived from painting #123).
